reproduction.expected: A ChatGPT or Codex Host can select one exact Starter Workflow, load the verified canonical SKILL.md, execute structured tools, persist digest-bound output/tool evidence, and resume the same TaskRun and LangGraph step without acquiring write or completion authority.
reproduction.actual: The runtime accepts only an injected synchronous SkillHostAdapter. It has no durable Host execution request/result contract, no WAITING_HOST checkpoint/resume state, and no validated natural-language Host selection proposal with exact confirmation for mutating routes.

violated_invariants: Reaching a Skill node must never be treated as proof that ChatGPT or Codex loaded and executed the Skill.
A Host handoff must resume the same TaskRun, Workflow, step, canonical Skill digest, and durable checkpoint.
Mutating natural-language requests must resolve to one exact reviewed entrypoint and effect preview before execution.
Host output or tool claims without digest-bound durable evidence must fail closed.
